text:
Alex: Hey team — unexpected travel. I need to hand primary off at 21:30 UTC. Current incident (INC-1234) is green but metrics still noisy. Can someone take primary for the next 8h?
Maria: I can take primary until morning if Jun can shadow. I’m on a call until 21:45 but can pick up after. :thumbsup:
Jun: I can shadow/secondary. I’ll be ready at 21:40. If anything spikes, ping me and I’ll escalate.
Sophia: I can be backup for the first 2h while Maria gets settled. Leaving a few runbook links here: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/latency-response and the short checklist: 
```
1) Check http://dashboards.redwood/latency
2) Verify model pool sizes (prod-gpu-pool)
3) Re-run healthcheck: /ops/healthcheck --scope=serving
4) If sustained token latency > 250ms, failover to smaller model variant
```
Alex: Thanks — leaving notes: last deploy at 19:10 UTC, canary looked fine. Observed 10% increase in tail latency at 20:55 but no errors. I’ll forward my pager to Maria now.
oncall-bot: @channel IncidentBot update: INC-1234 status -> resolved -> monitoring (auto-check) — next check in 5m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert forwarded to Maria.
Maria: Got the pager, accepted. I’ll post a quick pre-hand-off checklist in 5.
Maria: Quick status for whoever is primary:
- Current RPS: 2100 (stable)
- 95p latency: 190ms (down from 230ms)
- Error rate: 0.07% (normal)
- Active canary: model-x-1.2 (fallback configured)
Jun: Noted. If latency climbs back above 250ms please set routing weight to fallback model (model-x-1.1) with this command: 
```
./rbw set-weight --service=prod-infer --model=model-x-1.1 --weight=0.4
```
Sophia: Also add these quick observability checks to the handoff: logs for kvcache eviction, GPU mem pressure, and any OOM traces from inference logs. Link: https://logs.redwood/query?q=kvcache+evict
Alex: I’ve added a short blameless note in the incident doc and linked the customer impact section. No active customer escalations.
Maria: OK taking primary now. Jun you’re secondary, Sophia you’re hotshadow for first 2h. I’ll escalate to oncall-eng if anything urgent.
Jun: Acknowledged. I’ll enable tighter alerting threshold for tail latency (200ms) for the next 4 hours.
Sophia: Watching logs. Ping me if you want me to grab a trace.
Alex: Thanks everyone — forwarding my mobile and then going offline. :pray: Safe handoff.
Maria: Safe travels! :plane:
Jun: Locking in coverage. I’ll post again at 22:30 to confirm stability.
Sophia: +1.
